title: Figure 19. Atlas IIAS All-Mode Ship-Hit Contours with A = 3.45
description: Contour plot of "Crossrange Distance (nm)" versus "Downrange Distance (nm)" showing all-mode ship-hit probability contours at 10^-4, 10^-5 and 10^-6. The 10^-4 contour forms a small closed lobe near the launch point, and the outer contours extend past 25 nm downrange. In-plot labels read "Atlas IIAS," "All Mode P_I," and "B = 1,000, A = 3.45."
